name: standard_gamma
description: Representative upstream schema: aten::_standard_gamma(Tensor self, Generator? generator=None) -> Tensor. The artifact name maps to the private ATen canonical base _standard_gamma. Draws Gamma(self, 1) samples without mutating or aliasing self. Tests cover shape/dtype/device metadata, positivity, distribution moments, tiny concentrations, generator reproducibility and state advancement, input preservation, and rejected non-floating or float64 inputs.
